name: [Portal] Partner Portal section rights and user roles in the sandbox (BE)
description:
### Summary

The portal runs as admin pages inside the partner's **own** e-shop project — the test shop a partner uses for development — not as a separate application. User management on the Figma "Přidat uživatele" screen (node 321:13256) is therefore the project's existing `admin_users` + `admin_user_permissions` mechanism, and the shop section tree it shows (Objednávky, Produkty, … — "Testovačka" in the mockup) is that partner's own shop, behaving exactly as in any merchant admin. **Nothing is delegated into the merchant e-shops the partner manages**; that access is a separate concern under . What is genuinely new is the "Partnerský Portál" group at the bottom of the tree: the portal's own pages must be registered as grantable sections, gated so they surface only in partner projects, and the role set offered by the form must be confirmed. The screens themselves are .

### Why?

Without registered, grantable rows there is nothing behind the "Partner Portal" checkbox in the mockup — every user of a partner's project would see either all portal pages or none, with no way to differentiate.

Registration also decides whether the portal leaks. `cms2_admin_section_map` is a **global** table in `st_cms`, so a badly gated row shows up in every merchant's administration, not just in partner projects. Done right the enforcement is free — `PageAdmin::setRights()` already reads these rows; done wrong it means a second, divergent check path.

### What?

- Register the portal's pages in `cms2_admin_section_map` under the existing „Portál partnera" parent (see ) with `editableRights = 1`, correct `permissionParentId` inheritance and `permissionLevel`, plus `_lng` titles for every portal language.
- Gate those rows so they appear only in partner projects and never in an ordinary merchant administration.
- Confirm the role set the portal's user form offers — Figma shows only Manažer and Běžný uživatel — against `AdminUserRole` and `AdminUserRoleAssignmentService`.

### Acceptance Criteria

Portal pages are registered in 

cms2_admin_section_map

 with 

editableRights = 1

 and appear as checkboxes in the „Partnerský Portál" group of the rights tree

permissionParentId

 is set so that granting the parent grants its children, matching the behaviour of the rest of the tree

Regression test on an ordinary merchant project: the portal rows appear neither in its menu nor in its rights tree

cms2_admin_section_map_lng

 titles and slugs exist for cs, sk, en, hu and de, consistent with the naming agreed in 

The role set offered in the portal user form matches Figma (Manažer / Běžný uživatel) and is derived from 

AdminUserRoleAssignmentService

, not hardcoded in the form

Access is enforced solely through 

PageAdmin::setRights()

 (cms/packages/Layout/Model/PageAdmin.php:215-256) — no second check path; a user without the right gets the standard AccessForbidden / 403

Rights on the partner's own shop sections (Objednávky, Produkty, …) behave exactly as before — no change to the existing tree

Migration lands under 

migrations/{year}/{team}/cms/{taskId}/

 and 

make lint-migrations

 is clean

Tests cover both directions: a user holding the portal right reaches the page, a user without it does not; 

make tests-seed && make tests-run

 pass

### Technical notes

Repository facts established 2026-09-23:

- The section catalogue is global: `st_cms.cms2_admin_section_map` (database/schema/st_cms.sql:204-231). Relevant columns: `editableRights` (1 = appears in the rights tree), `permissionParentId` (child inherits the parent's grant), `permissionLevel`, `module`, `hideInactiveModule`, `inMenu`. Titles in `cms2_admin_section_map_lng` (:234).
- The grants are per-project: `admin_user_permissions(userId, pageId)` (database/schema/st_pattern.sql:154). Because the portal lives in the partner's own project, this is the ordinary single-silo case — no cross-silo write, no fan-out, no new storage.
- Runtime gate: `PageAdmin::setRights()` (cms/packages/Layout/Model/PageAdmin.php:215-256), resolving `permissionParentId` first; result consumed by cms/packages/Backend/Controller.php:275 and :947. Tree building: cms/packages/Layout/Model/BackendMap.php — `showEditableRightsOnly()` :88, `disableItemsWithParentPermissions()` :146, the `editableRights = 1` filter :247-249.
- Rendering precedent for the tree: admin/controllers/templates/AdminUserDetail.tpl:150-194 with the recursive sub/AdminUserDetailMapLine.tpl (checkbox `name="pageId[]"`); write path `AdminUserDetailController::savePermissions()` :322-353.
- Evidence that the tree is almost entirely pageIds: "Prodloužit zkušební období" is not a flag but section-map row id 1048 (`TrialProlongation`, `inMenu=0`, `editableRights=1`). The only true standalone column is `admin_users.accessToPurchasePrice` (database/schema/st_pattern.sql:188). So "Partner Portal" should almost certainly be pageId rows too — cf. Q3.
- Roles: `admin_users.role enum('user','partner','manager','owner')` (st_pattern.sql:177), enum at cms/packages/Profiles/Enum/AdminUserRole.php, offered set computed by cms/packages/Profiles/Service/AdminUserRoleAssignmentService.php:21-49. Note `PARTNER->permissionLevel()` returns 2 — the same as a standard user — and the role's only production consumer is the 2FA requirement, so it is a label rather than a privilege tier.
- The permission core is unowned in `CODEOWNERS` (repo root, not .github/): `cms/packages/Profiles`, `cms/packages/Layout` and `admin/controllers/AdminUser*` have no owning team. Nominate an owner before implementation.
